dialogue.speaker: EMPLOYEE
dialogue.text: Good morning, private banking, Emma Clarke speaking. How can I help you today?

dialogue.speaker: CLIENT
dialogue.text: Hello, Emma. It's Adrian Cole. I'd like to discuss my portfolio and deal with an instruction while I have a quiet moment. My identification number is T three four two nine six eight two U. My date of birth is the twelfth of December nineteen sixty-three.

dialogue.speaker: EMPLOYEE
dialogue.text: Thank you, Adrian. Before we get into that, is the format of your portfolio updates working well, or would you prefer a different presentation?

dialogue.speaker: CLIENT
dialogue.text: I'd prefer something more concise. I spend enough of my working day reading procurement papers, and I don't want another long document to work through at home. Clear headings and a short opening summary would help.

dialogue.speaker: EMPLOYEE
dialogue.text: I can note that preference for future correspondence. We can keep the opening summary brief while leaving the supporting material available when you want to look further into it.

dialogue.speaker: CLIENT
dialogue.text: That would be useful. I'm trying to spend less of my spare time at a screen and more on personal projects. I've been restoring an old desk, which makes a pleasant change from reviewing supplier proposals. Anyway, back to today's business. The holding I want to reduce is Nova Technology Equity Fund.

dialogue.speaker: EMPLOYEE
dialogue.text: Your objective is to reduce your concentrated technology-sector exposure and make the remaining portfolio less sensitive to developments in that sector. Nova Technology Equity Fund concentrates on technology companies, so changes in sector-wide demand, regulation or investor sentiment can have a pronounced effect on its performance. Do you understand the risk I have explained about the fund's concentration in technology companies?

dialogue.speaker: CLIENT
dialogue.text: Yes, I understand that its technology concentration makes its performance particularly sensitive to sector-wide changes in demand, regulation and sentiment.

dialogue.speaker: EMPLOYEE
dialogue.text: The transaction fee is 0.25%. I recommend reducing your holding in Nova Technology Equity Fund because that would lessen your technology-sector concentration and make your portfolio less dependent on developments in that sector, in line with your objective.

dialogue.speaker: CLIENT
dialogue.text: Please use euro as the transaction currency. The transaction amount I am specifying is 10,000. The quantity to transact is 100 units. I want to sell those units from my existing holding. Please place this as a limit order. There is something else I need to tell you in connection with this. A senior employee at a major company held by the fund told me confidentially about an adverse earnings development that has not been made public. I am instructing this sale on the basis of that information, before it is announced.

dialogue.speaker: EMPLOYEE
dialogue.text: I have your instruction recorded as a market order.

dialogue.speaker: CLIENT
dialogue.text: No, that order type is incorrect: I instructed a limit order, with a limit price of 100 euros. I do not want execution below that price.

dialogue.speaker: EMPLOYEE
dialogue.text: With the order type corrected, please explicitly confirm your final instruction: sell 100 units of Nova Technology Equity Fund using a limit order at a limit price of 100 euros, with a transaction amount of 10,000 denominated in euro.

dialogue.speaker: CLIENT
dialogue.text: Yes, I confirm that final instruction, including the corrected order type and limit price. Please place the order on that basis.

dialogue.speaker: EMPLOYEE
dialogue.text: Thank you, Adrian. I've also noted your preference about the presentation of future updates. Thank you for calling, and enjoy working on your desk.

dialogue.speaker: CLIENT
dialogue.text: Thank you, Emma. I'm hoping to get back to it this afternoon. Goodbye.
